_about: HIRES [more rare hires, each his own look], 11/3/26 (rule 351(a), Paolo 11/3: 'We need more rare characters'; he hires ONLY when he sees a rare one, so the rare ones are the reason to grow a crew). Grew from RUN TWO's three (10/25, rule 183(a): the road knight, the gun for hire, the blade master) to FOURTEEN, Battle Brothers' rare backgrounds as the floor (the library: reference/library/grok/wiki bb_all, every row's stat range, starting level and base wage in backgrounds.json; its spawn odds per slot in bb_all/0370) in the valley's 2050 skins. EACH MAN IS ONE PERSON OF THE VALLEY: 'look' is his own body and face (records/hires/BOHEMIA_HIRES_THE_RARE_ROLL.json, built and rendered by tools/bohemia_hires_the_rare_men.py on the master rig; no other man at any post, crowd or board wears it), so two rare men never look alike and a man you hired never stands at a post again. 'edge' is the one line his hire card reads: the perk he starts with (his trade taught it; it takes one of his level points, so it is the RIGHT perk, not an extra one) and what he brings. 'line' is his own mouth. Battle Brothers' way for the rest (RUN TWO's, kept): level 2 or 3, rolled in the TOP HALF of his background's range (TUNING 2 11/3, rule 370(4): 'good, not gods'; was the top quarter) with his levels taken on four picks a level off his plan, three talents (stars), his own kit on him, priced on the hall's formula (base + 500 x (level - 1)^1.5 + kit x 1.25, x the hall's four fifths; base: the Game Guide's 30 to 150 laid along the wiki's base wage, 40 + 4.4 x (wage - 10) to the nearest 10, the blade master's 400 kept), his wage his background's. 'tiers': where he can stand (Battle Brothers' villages hold the beast slayer, the retired soldier, the witch hunter and the wild men; our camp is its village). 'weight': his share among the men a slot may hold (Battle Brothers' own odds in 'bb.odds', the rarest kinds weight 1). THE CHANCE A SLOT HOLDS ONE IS TUNING'S: records/target/bb/ours.json rare_at_the_post (the one numbers table reads ours.json); chance_per_slot here is its fallback only. HALF OR MORE ARE MELEE (rule 351(a) amended, Paolo 11/3: 'more rare melee guys, all the rare guys I saw were ranged only'): eleven of the fourteen fight with their melee weapon in hand (kit.main), the pistol riding in the bag (kit.gun); the card shows his own weapon. Every word is draft:true (WORDS may rewrite any). A modder adds a man here: kind, background (a backgrounds.json id), look (a person in the people mix, or none: he then wears the slot's own look), tiers, weight, stars, plan, kit ids (weapons.json, armor.json), perk (a perks.json id), base_crowns, edge, line.
stat_floor_amended_11_3: TUNING 2 [the fight is close] 11/3 (VAMILY rule 370, ask line 396; records/BOHEMIA_TUNING_THE_FIGHT_IS_CLOSE_11_3_26.md): RARE MEN ARE GOOD, NOT GODS (370(4)): rolled in the TOP HALF of his background's range (was the top quarter, 10/25 'god-tier'), his three talents and his levels as before, so he still beats a lowborn at every stat that matters and a road knight still outfights any farmhand; Battle Brothers rolls a hedge knight in his whole range (bb_all/0973). MEASURED with the rest of this round's numbers (tools/bohemia_difficulty_the_curve.js --close, HIS WAY).
source: banks/BOHEMIA_TUNING_LONE_WOLF_10_25_26.json (the god-tier hire); reference/library/grok/wiki/PAGES_ALL.tar.gz bb_all/0370 (2.2 to 8.3%); records/target/bb/backgrounds.json missing note (base 30 to about 150, Swordmaster 400); bb_all/0370_Character Backgrounds_Sources.txt (each kind's own odds, 'bb.odds'); records/BOHEMIA_HIRES_FOURTEEN_RARE_MEN_11_3_26.md

men.edge: SHIELD EXPERT: his riot shield blocks more and lasts twice as long. Heavy chain, and the most breath at the post.
men.line: Three winters I held the 95 alone. Pay me and it is your road.
men.who: A highway patrol trooper who kept riding the 95 after the state stopped paying him.

men.edge: BULLSEYE: shoots past your own men and keeps his aim. Rifle, chain vest, helmet.
men.line: I hit what I aim at. You point, I pull. Simple.
men.who: A private military contractor's rifleman. The firm folded with the dollar; he kept the rifle.

men.edge: SWORD MASTERY: his sword tires him less and lands more. The surest blade and the hardest man to touch.
men.line: Guns jam. I do not. Ask the men who tried.
men.who: Thirty years the sword in a Strip casino's dinner show. The show closed; the blades stayed sharp.

men.edge: ADRENALINE: one tap and he goes first next round. The fastest man at any post.
men.line: I did collections. Nobody ever paid late twice.
men.who: The one the casinos sent when a debt could not be paid.

bb.odds: Blazing Deserts city-states only, no % row

men.edge: CRIPPLING STRIKES: his hits cripple, beast or man. Lever rifle, boar spear, a dire wolf's coat.
men.line: I fed them when they were pups. I know where they bite.
men.who: He kept the de-extinction lab's pens. When the money died the clones got out, and he knows every one.

bb.odds: cities and villages, no % row (Beasts & Exploration)

men.edge: RALLY THE TROOPS: brings running men back and steadies the line. Spear and car door: a wall on his own.
men.line: Two tours, one pension. The pension died first. Where do you want me?
men.who: A Guard sergeant whose pension died with the dollar. He still stands a line like it is drill.

men.edge: TAUNT: makes them swing at him, not at your weak men. The pit's helm and the pit's chain.
men.line: Half the lights were out and they still came to see me. Come see.
men.who: A cage fighter out of the Mob's pit, the crowd's favourite the year the lights went half out.

men.edge: STUDENT: a fifth more experience from every fight. The steadiest nerve at the post, in chrome.
men.line: My family owned a casino. Now I own a sword. I want a story.
men.who: A casino family's son, fenced at a private academy. The fortune went to zero; he wants a story.

men.edge: FORTIFIED MIND: a quarter more nerve; fear barely moves him. A rifle, a good eye, and cheap.
men.line: I have heard the broadcast. It did not take me. It will not take you.
men.who: He hunts the static listeners. He has heard the broadcast and it did not take him.

men.edge: PATHFINDER: rough ground costs him a step less. His bullwhip reaches two tiles.
men.line: I rode bulls before they were clones. These ones are slower.
men.who: A rodeo rider off the old circuit. The bulls are clones now.

bb.odds: desert city-states only, no % row (Blazing Deserts)

men.edge: COLOSSUS: a quarter more hitpoints, and harder to cripple. Swings a splitting maul.
men.line: Ten years up the mountain. I came down and your money was gone. Good.
men.who: Ten years off the grid in the Spring Mountains. He walked down and the money was gone.

bb.odds: the north, no % row (Warriors of the North)

men.edge: STEEL BROW: a hit to the head does him no extra harm. A baton, a crash-bar riot shield and the casino's own riot gear.
men.line: Twenty years I ran a floor. Nobody walked out with what was not theirs.
men.who: A casino's head of security, twenty years of the floor. The casino is dark; he is not.

bb.odds: events only in Battle Brothers (a noble house's guard); ours at the post

men.edge: NINE LIVES: once a fight, the blow that should kill him does not. Riot shield and a hammer.
men.line: I swore I would bring people back. I still do. Mostly.
men.who: A burned-out SWAT medic. He swore to bring them back and still does.

men.edge: FAST ADAPTATION: every miss makes his next swing surer. Armour cut from road signs.
men.line: My crew ate each other over a water tank. I walked. I can walk with you.
men.who: A convoy raider who walked off when his crew turned on each other.
